pr_title: Updating the nodeAffinity of gated pods having nil affinity should be allowed
pr_body:
This PR proposes a fix to address the update of the nodeAffinity when a gated pod has `nil` affinity before being updated. 

/kind bug

Steps to reproduce:

1. Create a pod as in the following using `kubectl create`:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  generateName: example-no-affinity-
spec:
  schedulingGate:
    - name: "example-gate" # just to ignore any other component that should add a scheduling gate in this context
  containers:
    - name: example-container
      image: 'quay.io/openshifttest/hello-openshift:1.2.0'
```
2. Try to update the pod as with:
```shell
 kubectl patch pod example-no-affinity-hz4lz -p '{"spec":{"affinity":{"nodeAffinity":{"requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution":{"nodeSelectorTerms":[{"matchExpressions":[{"key":"expr","operator":"In","values":["value"]}]}]}}}}}'

```
### Current result

```
The Pod "example-no-affinity-hz4lz" is invalid: spec: Forbidden: pod updates may not change fields other than `spec.containers[*].image`,`spec.initContainers[*].image`,`spec.activeDeadlineSeconds`,`spec.tolerations` (only additions to existing tolerations),`spec.terminationGracePeriodSeconds` (allow it to be set to 1 if it was previously negative)
  core.PodSpec{
        ... // 15 identical fields
        Subdomain:         "",
        SetHostnameAsFQDN: nil,
-       Affinity:          nil,
+       Affinity:          &core.Affinity{},
        SchedulerName:     "default-scheduler",
        Tolerations:       {{Key: "node.kubernetes.io/not-ready", Operator: "Exists", Effect: "NoExecute", TolerationSeconds: &300}, {Key: "node.kubernetes.io/unreachable", Operator: "Exists", Effect: "NoExecute", TolerationSeconds: &300}},
        ... // 13 identical fields
  }
```

### Expected result

The pod is updated.

issue_context.title: Updating the nodeAffinity of gated pods having nil affinity is not allowed
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

When a gated pod is created with nil affinity and a user/controller tries to update its nodeAffinity, the validation fails.

### What did you expect to happen?

The pod gets updated with the new affinity as per rules in [KEP-3838](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/commit/ac65b5853a9a5b8fb77a8c3069c07780057a4c9e)

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

1. Create a pod as in the following using `kubectl create`:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  generateName: example-no-affinity-
spec:
  schedulingGate:
    - name: "example-gate" # just to ignore any other component that should add a scheduling gate
  containers:
    - name: example-container
      image: 'quay.io/openshifttest/hello-openshift:1.2.0'
```
2. Try to update the pod as with:
```shell
 kubectl patch pod example-no-affinity-hz4lz -p '{"spec":{"affinity":{"nodeAffinity":{"requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution":{"nodeSelectorTerms":[{"matchExpressions":[{"key":"expr","operator":"In","values":["value"]}]}]}}}}}'

```

### Anything else we need to know?
